clinical_category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

semantic_correction.stem: A hospital is strengthening its antibiotic stewardship program. Which action best reflects the current CDC Core Elements?

options.A: Use prospective audit and feedback or preauthorization, track antibiotic use, and report findings to improve prescribing.
options.B: Increase broad-spectrum antibiotic use for admitted clients before a clinical indication has been established.
options.C: Avoid antibiotics whenever possible, including infections for which antibiotic treatment clearly benefits the client.
options.D: Restrict stewardship to outpatient settings because inpatient antibiotic prescribing is outside the CDC framework.

semantic_correction.rationale: CDC defines antibiotic stewardship as the effort to measure and improve how antibiotics are prescribed and used. The hospital Core Elements include action strategies such as prospective audit and feedback or preauthorization, tracking antibiotic prescribing and outcomes, reporting information on antibiotic use and resistance, and education. The goal is appropriate antibiotic use that improves patient care and combats antimicrobial resistance—not indiscriminate expansion or elimination of therapy. Therefore option A best reflects the CDC hospital stewardship framework.
semantic_correction.educational_objective: Describe hospital antibiotic stewardship as a structured patient-safety program that improves antibiotic prescribing through evidence-based interventions, tracking, and reporting.

audit_findings_append.finding: The original correct answer was uniquely longest and one distractor used an absolute. The revised item directly tests CDC stewardship actions with balanced alternatives.

option_audit.A: Correct. Prospective audit/feedback or preauthorization, tracking, and reporting are explicit CDC hospital stewardship elements.
option_audit.B: Incorrect. Stewardship seeks appropriate antibiotic use, not routine empiric broad-spectrum treatment without indication.
option_audit.C: Incorrect. Stewardship does not mean withholding clinically beneficial antibiotic therapy.
option_audit.D: Incorrect. CDC maintains a specific Core Elements framework for hospital antibiotic stewardship.

ambiguity_check: No second defensible answer. A alone consists of actions explicitly identified in the CDC hospital Core Elements.
cueing_check: All four choices are stewardship-program actions of comparable length and specificity; no absolute-word or unique-length cue identifies A.

checks: CDC Sept. 15, 2025 hospital Core Elements freshly verified
